title: RentGuard Late Charge Base for Long-Standing Policyholders
content:
**Decision table — base of the late charge by tenure, RentGuard Renters Policy**

Late charge base by tenure: when the whole months from the renters original effective date to today are 36 or more and no late charge was posted on the policy in the last 12 calendar months, the base of the late charge is 3.00 USD; when those whole months are 12 or more but fewer than 36 and no late charge was posted on the policy in the last 12 calendar months, the base of the late charge is 4.00 USD; in every other case the base of the late charge is the tier's late fee.

Tenure is counted in whole months from the policy's original effective date (its first inception date, not the start of the current term) to today. The late-charge history is read from the policy's premium account: any fee entry with fee code late fee posted in the last 12 calendar months counts.

| Whole months since original effective date | Late charge posted in last 12 calendar months? | Base of the late charge |
|---|---|---|
| 36 or more | No | 3.00 USD |
| 36 or more | Yes | The tier's late fee |
| 12 to 35 | No | 4.00 USD |
| 12 to 35 | Yes | The tier's late fee |
| Fewer than 12 | No | The tier's late fee |
| Fewer than 12 | Yes | The tier's late fee |

**Boundary points**

- 35 whole months with a clean late-charge record: 4.00 USD. At 36 whole months: 3.00 USD.
- 11 whole months: the tier's late fee. At 12 whole months with no late charge in the last 12 calendar months: 4.00 USD.
- A single late charge posted within the last 12 calendar months moves any tenure to the tier's late fee.

*Hypothetical case:* a policy first incepted 40 whole months ago, whose premium account shows its last late charge 14 months ago, has a base of 3.00 USD; had that late charge been posted 5 months ago, the base would be the tier's late fee.
